title: Issue citation list, schema version 1
description: One file per issue, data/citations/{serial}.json, listing every source that issue cites -- the input the source registry (data/sources/registry.json) and the evidence manifests (data/evidence/) are built from. Order matters: it is the order REF numbers are assigned in the evidence manifest, so append new citations rather than reordering. Replaces the single hand-appended CITATIONS list scripts/build_registry_backfill.py used to carry, so adding an issue is 'add one small file' instead of 'edit a growing script'.

canonical_name.description: Reuse the exact string already in the registry for this domain where one exists, so this citation folds into the same registry entry instead of minting a duplicate.

origin.description: Two-letter country code. Absent where not established with confidence; never guessed.
